name: Peñaranda de Duero (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and crimson, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Peñaranda de Duero (quartered with the arms of the Zúñiga and Avellaneda, with a sword).
history: Municipal flag of Peñaranda de Duero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Peñaranda de Duero arms — quartered Zúñiga and Avellaneda, with a sword
